snippet.title: 40 ఏళ్ల వైఎస్ ఆధిపత్యానికి బ్రేక్? #Chandrababu #Pulivendula #YSJagan #YCP #KutamiGovt #APElections
snippet.description:
Imagine a former Chief Minister and the leader of a political party with nearly 40% vote share being reduced to focusing on just one municipality! This is the unusual political situation unfolding in Andhra Pradesh, with Pulivendula becoming the centre of a major political battle. For decades, Pulivendula has been considered the stronghold of the YS family. Since YS Raja Reddy entered politics in 1978, the family has maintained its dominance in the region, whether in Gram Panchayat elections, Major Panchayat elections or after Pulivendula became a municipality in 2005. However, the political equation appears to be changing this time. YS Jagan Mohan Reddy has personally stepped into the election battle, showing unusual urgency to protect his family's traditional stronghold. Despite his direct involvement, the NDA alliance has made significant gains. Out of 40 wards, 20 have reportedly been elected unanimously in favour of the TDP, marking a major political development in Pulivendula's history. The contest has become even more interesting with Pramila, wife of YS Manohar Reddy, Jagan's uncle, entering the race. She is facing Geetha Kumari, wife of Tugutla Madhusudhan Reddy, representing the alliance. Meanwhile, TDP is gaining ground in several areas that were once considered strong YSRCP territories. The growing migration of YSRCP leaders and supporters towards TDP has added to the pressure on Jagan's party. With leaders like Adinarayana Reddy and B.Tech Ravi playing key roles, and Nara Lokesh providing strategic support, TDP appears determined to make a strong political statement in Pulivendula. The contrast with the 2019 political situation is also significant. After its defeat, TDP under Chandrababu Naidu actively fought local body elections, while Jagan's current approach has raised questions among YSRCP supporters. Is Pulivendula slowly slipping away from the YS family's control? Is this a warning sign for YSRCP across Andhra Pradesh? Watch the full video to understand the changing political equations and the growing challenge facing YS Jagan Mohan Reddy.

காதலித்து திருமணம் செய்த கணவனே இன்னொரு பெண்ணுக்காக அவளை அவமானப்படுத்தி வீட்டை விட்டு வெளியேற்றுகிறான். நம்பிய உறவுகள் கைவிட்டாலும், யாழினி தன் வாழ்க்கையை முடித்துக்கொள்ளவில்லை. அவளுக்குள் இருந்த ஒரு கனவைப் பற்றிக்கொண்டு போராடத் தொடங்குகிறாள்!

தோல்விகள் வந்தன… கண்ணீர் வந்தது… பல தடைகள் வந்தன… ஆனால் அவள் தன் முயற்சியைக் கைவிடவில்லை!

ஒருநாள் அவமானப்படுத்திய அதே கணவனுக்கு முன்பாக IAS மாவட்ட ஆட்சியராக தலைநிமிர்ந்து நிற்கிறாள்!

ஒரு பெண்ணின் உண்மையான பலம் அவளுடைய தன்னம்பிக்கையும் விடாமுயற்சியும்தான்! ❤️

snippet.description:
A helicopter carrying six people, including a pilot and five passengers from Karnataka, crashed in Joshimath Valley in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district, killing everyone on board. The chopper departed from Badrinath around 1:14 PM before crashing in the valley. The victims' mortal remains have been recovered and are being transported back to Karnataka. Moments before the fatal tragedy, passengers recorded videos from inside the chopper, capturing the journey and the cloudy conditions prior to takeoff. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has sent a team to conduct a preliminary assessment and investigate whether inclement weather contributed to the disaster. Serious concerns have emerged over aviation safety regulations and permissions granted to private helicopter operators along pilgrimage routes in the mountainous terrain.

Դիանա Գրիգորյանի դրամատիկ սերիալը՝ սիրո, ընտանիքի, գաղտնիքների և ճակատագրի համար պայքարի մասին։

Յուրաքանչյուր մարդ ունի իր գոյամարտը։ Մեկը պայքարում է սիրո համար, մյուսը՝ ընտանիքը պահելու, երրորդը՝ տարիներով թաքցված ճշմարտությունից չկոտրվելու համար։

«Գոյամարտ»-ը պատմում է մարդկանց մասին, որոնց կյանքում անցյալը նորից վերադառնում է՝ բացահայտելով ընտանեկան գաղտնիքներ, չմարված պարտքեր, հին վիրավորանքներ, վրեժի ծարավ և վտանգավոր ընտրություններ։ Երբ լռությունը այլևս չի կարող պաշտպանել ոչ մեկին, հերոսները ստիպված են կանգնել ճշմարտության առաջ և որոշել՝ փախչե՞լ ցավից, թե՞ մինչև վերջ պայքարել իրենց սիրո, ընտանիքի և արժանապատվության համար։

Սերիալում յուրաքանչյուր որոշում կարող է փոխել ճակատագրեր, յուրաքանչյուր բացահայտում՝ քանդել տարիներով կառուցված հարաբերություններ, իսկ յուրաքանչյուր պայքար դառնում է ոչ միայն արտաքին, այլև ներքին գոյամարտ։

snippet.title: Arnab Ke Baad Ab Bhutan Se Khatra: Bengal-Assam Alert #shorts
snippet.description:
29 October ki raat, Bhutan ke Gasa mein Shintaphu glacier jheel phat gayi. Lagbhag 74 lakh ghan metre paani Mo Chhu nadi mein utra, aur yahi nadi aage Sankosh banke seedha India mein aati hai, Bengal aur Assam ki seema par.

• Bhutan: Gasa ka hot spring beh gaya, sadkein tooti, upar ke gaon kat gaye (The Week, Business Today)
• India: Alipurduar aur Dhubri ke liye special flood advisory (Jal Shakti Mantralaya); Kokrajhar aur Dhubri par Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma ki nazar; Cooch Behar ke border belt mein NDRF/SDRF
• Alipurduar mein 10,000 se zyada log surakshit jagahon par bheje gaye (The Week)
• Sankosh lagbhag 1.5 metre chadhi, khatre ke nishaan se neeche (Alipurduar administration, 30 Oct)
• Shintaphu khud Bhutan ki 11 "potentially dangerous" jheelon mein se ek thi (Punatsangchhu basin: 2 Mo Chhu + 9 Pho Chhu). Bhutan mein ab 620 glacier jheelein hain, 2021 mein 567 thi (NCHM)

Apne ilaake ke liye CWC, state disaster management aur district administration ki official advisory follow karo.

Kya aapka ilaaka bhi Sankosh ke raaste mein hai? 👇 Comment mein batao.

snippet.title: Should You Eat All Your Halloween Candy at Once? #shorts
snippet.description:
Should you eat all your Halloween candy at once? Dentists say yes. The bacteria in the plaque on your teeth eat the sugar too, and make acid. That acid softens your enamel for 20 minutes or more after each sweet, until your spit washes it off (American Dental Association).

So it's how often you eat candy, not how much, that does the damage. Ten pieces spread through the day are ten acid attacks. Eat them all in one sitting and it's one. Dentists say the best time is with a meal, when you make the most spit, then drink some water or brush.

Send this to the friend who eats one piece an hour, and subscribe: we go inside the things you live with.
